title: Project 1
text: This project focuses on building R functions which query the U.S Census Berenau’s Public Use Microdata Sample (PUMS) API directly. Our objective is to practice working with REST API content by constructing request URLs, parsing raw JSON responses, and converting the results into useful type datatype.
